summary: Frontend-only verification of the welcome/empty screen bug fix in ChatInterface.jsx. Both cases (no conversation selected, and new conversation with 0 messages) now render an identical full welcome screen containing the product logo (.welcome-logo), welcome title ('Welcome to AI Delphi Council'), welcome subtitle, and the HowItWorks 4-card section (INPUT / ENRICH / PROCESS / OUTPUT). The old bare 'Start a conversation / Ask a question' text is no longer shown. In the 0-message conversation case, the message input form is still visible below and accepts typing; clicking Send correctly triggers the Cost Estimate modal (insufficient balance path). No regression observed.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatInterface.jsx duplicates the welcome-state block twice (no-conversation branch and 0-messages branch). Consider extracting a <WelcomeScreen documents={documents} activeDocuments={activeDocuments} /> component to avoid DRY violation and keep the two paths guaranteed identical going forward.

conversation.messages.length === 0 logic is repeated 3 times in the render (welcome block, loading indicator, input-area gating). Minor: could be hoisted to a const isEmpty = conversation.messages.length === 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) welcome-screen data-testid renders for no-conversation. (2) After clicking [data-testid=btn-new-conversation], .welcome-state renders again with same logo + title 'Welcome to AI Delphi Council' + subtitle 'Create a new conversation to get started.' + How it works section. (3) [data-testid=input-message] accepts input. (4) Clicking [data-testid=btn-send] opens the Cost Estimate modal (0 credits balance → Insufficient balance shown). Terms & Conditions modal appears on first login — must check '#input[type=checkbox]' then click 'Accept & continue' button (not just any 'Accept' text) to dismiss.
